content: 'Southern Charm' is back, with returning Charmers Venita Aspen, Salley Carson, Craig Conover, Austen Kroll, Madison LeCroy, Molly O’Connell, Rodrigo Reyes, Whitner Slagsvol and Shep Rose, plus one new face: Allie Newman, a Charleston-based model, friend of Venita’s and former flame of Austen! After a reunion where the status of friendships and situationships remained ambiguous, the Holy City crew is determined to define their relationships and mend wounds. However, when true feelings bubble up and juicy rumors catch fire (a secret love child?!), the group seeks to unveil the truth... even if it costs them more than just friendships. Fan-favorite Patricia Altschul and her son, Whitney-Sudler Smith, as well as Charley Manley and Shep's ex, Taylor Ann Green, are set for season 12, as well, which premieres on Thursday, Nov. 12, at 9 p.m. ET/PT on Bravo. Episodes stream next day on Peacock.
